title: RFCTLARR Act 2013: central provisions
source: India Code: Act 30 of 2013 (with state amendments), verified 2026-09-29

entries.label: Window to object after the preliminary notification
entries.quote: Any person interested in any land which has been notified under sub-section (1) of section 11 … may within sixty days from the date of the publication of the preliminary notification, object

entries.label: Declaration (s.19) must follow the preliminary notification within
entries.quote: Where no declaration is made under sub-section (1) within twelve months from the date of preliminary notification, then such notification shall be deemed to have been rescinded
entries.note: Periods of court stay or injunction are excluded; the appropriate Government may extend the period, recorded in writing and notified.

entries.label: Award must follow the s.19 declaration within
entries.quote: The Collector shall make an award within a period of twelve months from the date of publication of the declaration under section 19 and if no award is made within that period, the entire proceedings for the acquisition of the land shall lapse
entries.note: The appropriate Government may extend the period, recorded in writing and notified.

entries.label: Compensation to be paid or tendered within, from the award
entries.quote: The Collector shall take possession of land after ensuring that full payment of compensation as well as rehabilitation and resettlement entitlements are paid or tendered to the entitled persons within a period of three months for the compensation

entries.label: Monetary R&R entitlements to be paid within, from the award
entries.quote: a period of six months for the monetary part of rehabilitation and resettlement entitlements listed in the Second Schedule commencing from the date of the award

entries.label: Infrastructural R&R entitlements to be provided within, from the award
entries.quote: components of the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Package in the Second and Third Schedules that relate to infrastructural entitlements shall be provided within a period of eighteen months from the date of the award

entries.label: Factor on market value, urban areas
entries.quote: Factor by which the market value is to be multiplied in the case of urban areas: 1 (One).

entries.label: Factor on market value, rural areas, by distance from urban area
entries.quote: 1.00 (One) to 2.00 (Two) based on the distance of project from urban area, as may be notified by the appropriate Government.
entries.note: The Act fixes only the 1.00–2.00 range; the distance bands are notified by each state. These bands are an illustrative placeholder.

entries.label: Solatium, as a share of the compensation
entries.quote: impose a “Solatium” amount equivalent to one hundred per cent. of the compensation amount

entries.label: Additional amount on market value, per year
entries.quote: award an amount calculated at the rate of twelve per cent. per annum on such market value for the period commencing on and from the date of the publication of the notification of the Social Impact Assessment study under sub-section (2) of section 4 … till the date of the award of the Collector or the date of taking possession of the land, whichever is earlier

entries.label: Additional amount runs from
entries.note: From the s.4(2) SIA notification, not the s.11 notification. Where a project is exempt from SIA, the s.11 date is used and flagged as unverified.

entries.label: Interest on compensation unpaid at possession, first year
entries.quote: When the amount of such compensation is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, the Collector shall pay the amount awarded with interest thereon at the rate of nine per cent. per annum from the time of so taking possession until it shall have been so paid or deposited

entries.label: Interest after one year from possession
entries.quote: if such compensation or any part thereof is not paid or deposited within a period of one year from the date on which possession is taken, interest at the rate of fifteen per cent. per annum shall be payable from the date or expiry of the said period of one year

entries.label: Tender before urgency possession
entries.quote: the Collector shall tender payment of eighty per cent. of the compensation for such land as estimated by him

entries.label: Additional compensation for urgency acquisition
entries.quote: An additional compensation of seventy-five per cent. of the total compensation as determined under section 27, shall be paid

entries.label: First instalment to SC/ST families
entries.quote: at least one-third of the compensation amount due shall be paid to the affected families initially as first instalment

entries.label: Parcel in a Scheduled Area (Fifth Schedule) needs
entries.quote: In case of acquisition or alienation of any land in the Scheduled Areas, the prior consent of the concerned Gram Sabha or the Panchayats or the autonomous District Councils … shall be obtained, in all cases of land acquisition in such areas, including acquisition in case of urgency, before issue of a notification
entries.note: Not overridable: the Act requires consent "in all cases".

entries.label: Parcel overlapping forest land needs
entries.citation: Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980, s.2; Forest Rights Act, 2006
entries.note: Prior Central Government approval for non-forest use, and settlement of forest rights. Citation not yet verified against the statute text in this build.

entries.label: Parcel overlapping a pending forest-rights claim needs
entries.citation: Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006, s.4(5)
entries.note: No removal until recognition and verification are complete. Citation not yet verified against the statute text in this build.

entries.label: Parcel in a Coastal Regulation Zone needs
Parcel in a protected area or its eco-sensitive zone needs
entries.citation: Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972; Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife

entries.label: Warn officers this many days before a statutory deadline

title: RFCTLARR Act 2013 as amended for Maharashtra (Maharashtra Act 37 of 2018)
source: India Code: Act 30 of 2013 (with state amendments), verified 2026-09-29

entries.label: Lump-sum R&R for linear projects, as a share of s.27 compensation
entries.citation: RFCTLARR 2013, s.31A (Maharashtra), inserted by Maharashtra Act 37 of 2018, s.6
entries.quote: it shall be competent for the State Government to pay … in case of projects which are linear in nature … as Rehabilitation and Resettlement cost, such lump sum amount equal to fifty per cent. of the amount of compensation as determined under section 27 to the affected families

entries.label: Award by agreement of all interested persons
entries.citation: RFCTLARR 2013, s.23A (Maharashtra), inserted by Maharashtra Act 37 of 2018, s.4
entries.quote: if at any stage of the proceedings, the Collector is satisfied that all the persons interested in the land who appeared before him have agreed in writing on the matters to be included in the award … he may, without making further enquiry, make an award according to the terms of such agreement

entries.label: State may exempt listed projects from Chapters II and III (SIA, food security)
value: rural infrastructure incl. irrigation and electrification
entries.citation: RFCTLARR 2013, s.10A (Maharashtra), inserted by Maharashtra Act 37 of 2018, s.3
entries.quote: The State Government may, in the public interest, by notification in the Official Gazette, exempt any of the following projects from the application of the provisions of Chapter II and Chapter III of this Act

entries.label: Factor on market value, rural Maharashtra, by distance from urban area
entries.citation: RFCTLARR 2013, First Schedule, item 2; Maharashtra notification (reference to be confirmed)
entries.note: Placeholder bands. Replace with the factors in the Maharashtra Government notification under the First Schedule before any real use.
